news_items_published_ck.name: news_items_published_ck
news_items_published_ck.value: "news_items"."status" <> 'PUBLISHED' OR ("news_items"."summary" IS NOT NULL AND "news_items"."state_id" IS NOT NULL)

party_leaders_quote_ck.name: party_leaders_quote_ck
party_leaders_quote_ck.value: "party_leaders"."quote" IS NULL OR "party_leaders"."quote_source_url" IS NOT NULL

party_leaders_photo_ck.name: party_leaders_photo_ck
party_leaders_photo_ck.value: "party_leaders"."photo_key" IS NULL OR ("party_leaders"."photo_license" IS NOT NULL AND "party_leaders"."photo_source_url" IS NOT NULL)

promises_has_maker.name: promises_has_maker
promises_has_maker.value: "promises"."term_id" IS NOT NULL OR "promises"."party_id" IS NOT NULL

promises_deadline_after_made.name: promises_deadline_after_made
promises_deadline_after_made.value: "promises"."deadline" IS NULL OR "promises"."made_on" IS NULL OR "promises"."deadline" >= "promises"."made_on"
